summary: Solowin Holdings filed a Form 6-K containing a press release and investor presentation celebrating its tenth anniversary and highlighting its evolution into a compliance-first AI and stablecoin ecosystem. The release recounts historical milestones: operations began in Hong Kong in 2016, Nasdaq listing in 2023, virtual-asset upgrade in 2024, and acquisition of AlloyX Limited in 2025. It also notes a full stablecoin issuance license from the Central Bank of Bahrain in 2026 and the world's first Sharia-compliant stablecoin certification. No transaction, tender, spin-off, or capital return is announced; the filing is purely promotional, describing ongoing operational platforms. There are no deal terms, recommendations, or risk-arb angles. The filing is a routine corporate update, not a special situation.
